The receptionist had an excellent phone manner and was really professional and helpful. Really knowledgeable about the GPs that work there and was noticeably making an effort to match me up with someone who would best meet my needs. Even to the extent of saying and if you have the appointment and you don't feel like they're the right match (I'm seeking continuity of care) then just let them know and I can try someone else. Well done - recognising that it's the patient's right to choose someone who we feel actually cares about us as a human and we're not just an NHS number.  A refreshing change.
